items.claim: Zero-thickness box goes to the earliest page it touches, not the one holding most of its length
`createPageRun` on an already-paged scene makes a second run that every page reader ignores
`adoptLegacyPages` throws a raw `TypeError` on a `core:pages` value that is not a `PagesDoc`
items.note: (the editor's `checkPagesDoc` moved into core as `pagesDocFault` and is used by both adopters)

items.claim: An unknown `align` (`'middle'`, or `'toString'` found on the prototype) or a string `gap` lays pages out at NaN, in `layoutPages` and in a loaded `pageRun`
items.note: (`pageLayoutFault`; `layoutPages` throws on bad options, and loading a scene refuses a saved page run holding them)
